name: Kunhegyes (Hungary)
description: A vertical medium blue banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Kunhegyes (a white shield with a horse, with a helm, a crest and red and yellow mantling) above the name KUNHEGYES in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kunhegyes arms with helm, crest and mantling
